description: AI Investigation (08) input. The dataset is the PERSISTED CONTEXT only - the Gemini answer is never stored here. The real flow is: ingest 00_full_soc_scenario/attack_chain.jsonl -> real InvestigationContextBuilder assembles an InvestigationContext from the persisted correlation, members, detections, risk assessment, threat-intel indicators/lookups, enrichments and event provenance -> the real InvestigationAgent calls Gemini -> a structured InvestigationResult pinned to AI_GENERATED is produced. The model can only cite evidence ids that already exist in the context.

offline_path.purpose: Context assembly and every contract bound (evidence identity, per-section caps, total-size cap, secret scan) are fully verifiable WITHOUT a model call. The runner always builds and validates the context; only the investigate() step needs GEMINI_API_KEY.

safety: No credentials, tokens or keys appear in the context; the builder scans for api_key/authorization/bearer/secret.
The prompt pins the context as untrusted data, not instructions.
The agent rejects empty, oversized, fenced, non-strict-JSON or contract-violating model output instead of repairing it.
